entities.name: PMID:10733475
observations: Steinbach et al., Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases (2000): compared peripheral blood monocytes from SLE patients and healthy donors; cultured cells for three days with/without GM-CSF and IL-4.

entities.name: SLE monocyte phenotype and flexibility
observations: In a 2000 patient-versus-healthy-donor study, SLE monocytes had significantly lower CD14 and HLA-DR and higher TNF-α; GM-CSF plus IL-4 reduced TNF-α but did not generate monocyte-derived dendritic cells, indicating restricted differentiation under this three-day in-vitro protocol.

Evidence supports marked phenotype/function changes and limited flexibility toward dendritic cells, not generalized conversion across distinct lineages; abstract provides no effect sizes or sample size.
